name: element.search
title: Search elements
summary: Full-text search over title, text, properties and IDs of the elements of a selection, typo tolerant, in any case, the best first, each hit with where it was found and a snippet around the match; optionally in groups.

query.description: Words split at spaces; every word must match (in the title, the text, a property value, the type or status name, or an ID). A word matches words it begins (from 2 letters) and with a typo (1 edit from 4 letters, 2 from 8; none for a query word with a digit), in any case. A short ID, an identifier or at least 6 hex digits of a UUID match that element exactly; ID matches come first. A query without a word finds nothing.

selection.description: Search only within it (SR-068 AK3): a view, a filter, a package or IDs.

fields.description: Search only these: `title`, `text` (the Markdown text), `properties` (every other value, type and status names; not relations), `id` (UUID, short ID, identifier). Default all.

group.description: Group the hits (SR-149 AK6) by the keys and rules of element.list `group`: the same groups in the same order, a hit with several values in each of their groups, the hits without a value (or with only targets not available) in the last group, and an invalid key `input.invalid` whatever the query finds. Inside each group the hits keep the order of the search (ID matches, then relevance, then workspace order). The grouping reads the records the hits were found in; their targets are looked up in the workspace the selection was read from. Nothing is stored.

withVerification.description: Also give what each row shows of its element's verification (SR-137), in `rowVerification`.

output.description: One page of the hits, the best first: ID matches, then relevance, then workspace order. Waits for the search index while it is built. The hits of the page read their files for the snippet (SR-174).

hits.description: One page of the hits. With `group`, the page of the grouped rows (the hits of the first group, then of the next): a hit in several groups is a row in each, so a page can hold it more than once; key the rows by their position, not by the element.

repository.description: Workspace name of the repository of the element.

identifier.description: The value of the property with the meaning identifier, when the element has one.

status.description: The status key as written in the file.

score.description: Relevance of the matched words, rounded to 6 significant digits; 0 for an ID match only.

fields.description: What a word of the query was found in.

terms.description: The words of the element that matched, in lower case, for highlighting; none for an ID.

titleMarks.description: The matched words in `title` (SR-174 AK4); only when a word was found in the title.

snippet.description: Where a word was found and one line around the first match in reading order (SR-174): in the text when a visible word of it matched, else in the first property value with a match, the properties of the type in metamodel order, then the others in file order. `text` is at most 120 code points, `…` at a cut end included: the visible text without Markdown characters, white space as single spaces; `marks` are the matched words in it. A list item or a nested value is a value of its own; a choice shows its name. None when no visible word matched: a match only in the title, an ID, the identifier, the type or status name, a link destination, HTML or an entity, or a file changed since the index read it.

propertyName.description: Its name in the metamodel; the key for a property the metamodel does not define.

groups.description: Only with `group`: every group of all the hits in order, also those on other pages; a group without hits is not given. `offset` and `rows` follow from the counts.

offset.description: Only with `group`: the row the page starts at (the `offset` of the input).

rows.description: Only with `group`: the rows of the grouped hits, the sum of the counts of `groups`; `offset` and `limit` page over these rows. At least `total`, more when hits are in several groups.

rowVerification.description: Only with `withVerification`: for each row of `hits`, in the same order, the verification status of a requirement and the progress ring of a requirement or need, as a node of trace.graph carries them (SR-137 AK1, AK3).
